description: Read the monthly Brazil email security report: how many domains of city halls, state and federal government, banks and listed companies reject fake email (DMARC p=reject) and how they end SPF. Totals only, public DNS. Free, no account. Public DNS only, read once a month. The sample is built from Brazil's open company registry (Receita Federal, the email of each active head office) and the CVM register of listed companies. Only totals: no domain is listed. A share is `count / (com_mx - dmarc.nao_lido)`; domains without MX are left out.
name: commsharbor_brazil_email_report
title: Commsharbor brazil email report
